author: planner
text:
The gap is an `online_sellby_breach` for "Cream 200G" (SKU-CREAM-200G) at node DS-05, with 157 units at risk and a deadline of 2026-09-16. The policy prefers bundles and transfers over markdowns. Since this is an online sell-by breach, the product can only be moved through outlets.

I will draft two plays:
1. A transfer to an outlet.
2. An outlet markdown.

I will then estimate the outcomes for both and propose the one with the higher expected margin, provided it passes all guardrails.

For the transfer play, I will choose `OUT-03` as the destination node, as it is the first transfer candidate. For the outlet markdown, I will set a markdown price that respects the category margin floor of 8%. The current list price is 130.0 and the unit cost is 102.49. An 8% margin means a net price of 102.49 / (1 - 0.08) = 111.40. I will set the markdown price to 115.0 to ensure it is above the floor.

For both plays, I will include all available audience segments, as there is a hard deadline and no specific guardrail or policy reason to exclude any. The holdout will be 5% with a seed and `min_treated_n` set to 1.
